label: Start instance infra
description: Bring up one instance's own copy of an infra node marked `@per_instance`. Fires `done` once the copy answers, so the instance's triggers that read it can be activated right after. However long the copy takes to come up, the run waits without holding a worker; a copy that fails to come up fails the node with the reason. Starting a copy that already runs does nothing.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node marked `@per_instance`, named the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the copy is running. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen after.

then.message: StartInstanceInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
